title: 第9章 什么叫演技第10章 在座的各位都是垃圾
content_zh:
云极在一阵天旋地转中醒来。
一睁眼，天都快亮了。
昏厥了半宿，至少确定一件事。
灵珠里绝对有个神魂，而且是女魂。
很容易分辨。
男魂听到肉偿这句话，只有三个反应。
正派人士：不屑一顾，灵珠正常转动，并吐出一口唾沫表示鄙夷。
邪派人士：邪魅一笑，灵珠倒转，并附加条件先去变成女人再说。
龙阳人士：臀来！
绝对没有第四种。
只有女人才会如此小气，直接把你踢出来，根本不给你任何解释的机会。
“呵，女人。”
云极腹诽了一句，心情反而不错。
如果灵珠是个死物，那么三十万灵石的天价债务只能如数偿还，否则就得消耗寿元。
纵然云极有天大的本事，在如今境界低微欠债无数的被动局面之下也得挠头。
毕竟三十万灵石对炼气境修士来说根本不敢想象，对筑基境的高手一样是天文数字。
好在灵珠是活物，那就有了周旋的空间。
威逼利诱，投其所好，软硬兼施，实在不行云极还有终极杀招。
分期付款！
欠你三十万灵石是吧，咱多给利息，我给六十万，分六十年还清，一年才还一万灵石。

“发明分期的，真他么是个小天才。”
云极暗自嘀咕了一句。
前世这么干绝对是个沉重的包袱，可这里是修仙界，能用灵石绑住个神秘大佬自然求之不得。
六十万灵石算个屁，没准大佬一高兴，咱就人间无敌了。
正准备去吃点早饭，一个四十来岁的中年男人闯进灵堂。
进来就开嚎。
“大哥！你怎么说走就走了啊！都没给二弟看一眼的机会，大哥呀！二弟来迟一步！嗷嗷嗷嗷！”
这位哭得那叫一个凄惨，几次背过气去，只是没等倒地又清醒过来，接着嚎哭。
云极坐着没动，看着对方表演。
假得不能再假了。
看着背过气，其实是没人扶而已，他自己不肯当真跌倒，甚至连眼泪都挤不出来。
content_en:
Yunji woke up to a sudden whirlwind.
When I opened my eyes, it was almost dawn.
After fainting for half a night, I was sure of at least one thing.
There is definitely a soul in the spirit bead, and it is a female soul.
It's easy to tell.
When the male soul heard these words, he had only three reactions.
Decent people: dismissive, rotate the spirit beads normally, and spit out a mouthful of saliva to express contempt.
Evil sect person: With an evil smile, the spirit orb was turned upside down, and he added the condition that he must first become a woman.
People from Longyang: Come on!
There is absolutely no fourth kind.
Only a woman would be so stingy and kick you out without giving you any chance to explain.
"Oh, woman."
Yunji sneered, but was in a good mood.
If the spirit bead is a dead object, then the sky-high price debt of 300,000 spirit stones can only be repaid in full, otherwise life span will be consumed.
Even though Yunji has great abilities, he still has to scratch his head in the current passive situation of low status and countless debts.
After all, 300,000 spirit stones are simply unimaginable for Qi Refining Realm monks, and are an astronomical figure for Foundation Establishment Realm masters.
Fortunately, the spirit bead is a living creature, so there is room for maneuver.
Coercion and inducement, giving in to what he wants, using both soft and hard tactics, but if that doesn't work, Yunji has the ultimate killing move.
installment!
I owe you 300,000 spirit stones, right? Let’s pay more interest, and I’ll give you 600,000. I’ll pay it back in sixty years, and only 10,000 spirit stones will be repaid in one year.
"Whoever invented staging is really a little genius."
Yunji muttered to himself.
Doing this in the previous life was definitely a heavy burden, but this is the world of immortality, so being able to tie up a mysterious boss with spiritual stones is a natural dream.
600,000 spiritual stones are nothing. Maybe if the boss is happy, we will be invincible in the world.
Just as he was about to have some breakfast, a middle-aged man in his forties broke into the mourning hall.
Come in and start howling.
"Brother! Why did you just leave when you said you were leaving! You didn't even give the second brother a chance to take a look. Big brother! The second brother came a step late! Ouch! Ouch!"
This man cried so miserably that he lost his breath several times, only to wake up again before he fell to the ground and continue howling.
Yunji sat still, watching the other party's performance.
It couldn't be more fake.
It looked like he was defeated, but in fact it was because no one was helping him. He refused to take the fall seriously and couldn't even squeeze out tears.
